movie.title: The Lost Chapter: Yuki's Revenge
movie.overview: Visionary director Quentin Tarantino had a dream of a Kill Bill chapter that never made it to the silver screen, a chapter known as "Yuki's Revenge." Over twenty years later, Tarantino and Epic have come together to bring the story to life in Fortnite.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Brought to life inside Fortnite using Unreal Engine, Quentin Tarantino's long-lost Kill Bill chapter follows Yuki Yubari as she seeks vengeance against The Bride for the death of her twin sister, Gogo.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: More than two decades after its original conception, Quentin Tarantino partnered with Epic Games to adapt an unproduced chapter of Kill Bill into a stylish animated short film. The narrative centers on Yuki Yubari, who vows relentless revenge against The Bride following the violent death of her twin sister, Gogo. Rendered entirely within Fortnite using Unreal Engine, the project blends Tarantino's signature stylized martial-arts combat with distinct video-game aesthetics. Ultimately, it expands the mythos of the original films by giving life to a legendary piece of lost cinematic lore.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Over twenty years after the release of Kill Bill, visionary director Quentin Tarantino partnered with Epic Games to finally bring 'The Lost Chapter: Yuki's Revenge' to life as a cinematic animated short inside Fortnite. Originally written as an integral sequence for the film, the chapter was cut prior to production and remained a mythic piece of script trivia among fans. The story picks up in the aftermath of Gogo Yubari's demise at the House of Blue Leaves, focusing on her grieving and vengeful twin sister, Yuki. Driven by hatred, Yuki meets with Bill and embarks on a murderous quest to hunt down and eliminate The Bride. Utilizing Unreal Engine and digital Fortnite character models, Tarantino directs the short with his trademark flair, featuring razor-sharp dialogue, neon-drenched settings, and blood-soaked martial-arts choreography. Uma Thurman reprises her role as The Bride, bringing authentic vocal gravity to the lethal confrontation. The short seamlessly merges classic cinema traditions with interactive media, transforming a legendary lost script page into a striking digital spectacle.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Lost Chapter: Yuki's Revenge realizes a previously unproduced segment written by Quentin Tarantino for his iconic Kill Bill saga. Following the death of assassin Gogo Yubari during her duel with The Bride, Gogo's twin sister, Yuki Yubari, sets out on a relentless path of vengeance. Supported by Bill, Yuki hunts down Beatrix Kiddo to avenge her sister's fate in a high-stakes, stylized martial-arts showdown. Produced in collaboration with Epic Games and rendered through Unreal Engine inside Fortnite, this animated project presents Tarantino's classic narrative vision through cutting-edge digital animation while maintaining the gritty tone, iconic action, and dramatic flair of the original film universe.
